disposition.a1_03_status: chart-driven realization closed; the track is not closed

headline: The A1-03 trio candidate lost. It realizes harmony and no melody, and a chord chart played that way is a lounge idiom -- which is what the owner heard.

named_gap_this_verdict_creates.gap: a reconstruction of Flim requires the tune. Nothing in the lane recovers or realizes melody, and a chord chart is not the piece
named_gap_this_verdict_creates.why_not: a negative result does not authorize an architecture program. This is recorded as the demand a future A1-03 commission would have to name, not as work starting

retained_evidence: the corrected bass-root chart over the whole form
the crate rack build and its PCM identity

verdict.aimed_at: the object, not the mix; both cuts in the pack share the comp that produces the character the verdict named
verdict.decisive: the realization contains no melody. Flim's identity is its tune; the recovery never attempted one and the object never carried one, so what was left is a chord chart played as block voicings on two and four over a walking bass. That is a lounge idiom, and no revision of the bass figure, the drum sound or the balance reaches it
verdict.why_nothing_is_credited: the owner granted no musical positive, and inventing one from the machine result would misreport the verdict

what_this_does_not_close.ace_step: stays where its own disposition left it, neither adopted nor rejected globally
what_this_does_not_close.the_crate_rack_path: not condemned. It rendered the parts it was given, and they were measured playing what they were written to play; the parts themselves were the wrong parts
what_this_does_not_close.the_recovered_clock: the performance's own grid is still the lane's timing authority
what_this_does_not_close.the_track: A1-03 keeps its commission. A failing mechanism ends that mechanism
